description:
DENMO PRIVATE LIMITED is an India-based travel technology company developing an AI-powered B2C online travel platform designed to transform how people discover, plan and book their journeys.

Our platform aims to bring travel inspiration, intelligent trip planning and bookings together in one place. At the core of our business is an AI-powered Trip Planner that will help travellers create personalised itineraries based on their budgets, preferences, travel dates, interests and travel styles. We also plan to introduce influencer-curated travel itineraries, enabling customers to explore destinations, discover experiences recommended by their favourite travel creators and turn that inspiration into bookable trips.

Our proposed services include domestic and international hotel and flight bookings, holiday packages, group travel, tours and activities, travel insurance through authorised partners, self-drive car rentals, airport transfers, car rentals, bus bookings, cruise holidays and corporate travel solutions.

Through technology integrations and partnerships with established travel suppliers, we aim to create a convenient and connected travel ecosystem that simplifies the entire booking journey.

Our vision is to build a technology-driven travel platform that combines AI-powered personalisation, authentic creator-led experiences and comprehensive travel services. We aim to reduce the time and complexity involved in planning a trip while making travel more accessible, personalised and convenient for individuals, families and groups.
